description: Quality Policy Drift Guard - Detect and prevent drift between runtime gate behavior and authoritative quality policy in docs/quality/*.

userStories.title: Define repeatable runtime-policy conformance checks
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want assurance that runtime gates still obey documented quality criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime-vs-policy conformance checks are defined and repeatable
Conformance checks validate runtime quality-gate behavior against docs/quality/* contracts
researchTopics: Current runtime gate evaluation entry points across workflow modes
Authoritative policy contract surfaces under docs/quality/*
userStories.notes: Derived from PRD-035 goals and acceptance criteria. Depends on PRD-032 and PRD-034.

userStories.title: Detect threshold and blocker-semantic drift across modes
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want drift alerts before they affect release decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Drift in thresholds or blocker semantics is detected with actionable output
Manual, hybrid, and full-auto paths are all covered by drift checks
researchTopics: Threshold and blocker-semantics mapping used by current gate logic
Failure modes where heuristic shortcuts or partial overrides cause drift
userStories.notes: Prioritizes early detection to protect release-decision consistency.

userStories.title: Persist conformance evidence with explicit policy-runtime diffs
userStories.description: As an auditor, I want evidence of policy conformance checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Conformance results are persisted as auditable evidence artifacts
Conformance output provides explicit policy-vs-runtime diffs for mismatches
Release acceptance semantics remain deterministic across workflow modes
researchTopics: Evidence artifact schema and storage locations for conformance outputs
Deterministic GO/NO_GO signal mapping for policy drift outcomes
userStories.notes: Aligns with auditability and deterministic release semantics goals from PRD-035.
